Does the civilization generation system have an analogous source of emergent quality, where the interaction between axes produces civilizations more interesting than any axis predicts?

Call changes and conductor decisions: a conductor calls changes that steer the peal through permutation space, making real-time decisions within constraints. The curator (LLM advisor) is mentioned as potentially recommending dig sites and interpreting artifacts â is this a conductor role?
